blocks.html: Normalized events from payment provider to internal payment module events. In principle, these should match the payment status.

types.name: AUTHORIZED
types.description: Payment session has been authorized and there are available funds for capture.

types.name: SUCCESSFUL
types.description: Payment was successful and the mount is captured.

types.name: NOT_SUPPORTED
types.description: Received an event that is not processable.

types.name: PENDING_AUTHORIZATION
types.description:
Payment authorization is pending and expected to complete asynchronously
(e.g., bank transfers, payment links, vouchers).
